sloka: राक्षसानामुपरि खे भ्रमते ऽलातचक्रवत् ।कपोता रक्तपादाश्च शारिका विद्रुता ययुः ॥
transliteration: rākṣasānāmupari khe bhramate 'lātacakravat ।kapotā raktapādāśca śārikā vidrutā yayuḥ ॥

translations.english: Above the Rakshasas, the vultures hovered in the sky like a fiery wheel, while red-footed pigeons and mynah birds fled, and two-footed cats and crows cawed right there.
